title: An etale scheme map to an algebraic space is surjective etale onto an open image
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $U$ be an $S$-scheme, within the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $f:h_U\to X$ be a representable etale morphism; representability, etaleness and surjectivity are tested on all scheme base changes as in [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Then there is an algebraic space $X_f$ over $S$, identified with a subfunctor of $X$, whose inclusion $j:X_f\hookrightarrow X$ is representable and becomes an open immersion on every scheme base change [def-weil-open-immersion], and a factorization $f=j\circ f_f$ with $f_f:h_U\to X_f$ representable, surjective and etale. The underlying set $|X_f|\subseteq |X|$ is exactly the image of $|U|\to |X|$. Here $|X|$ is the set of field-valued point classes: maps $\operatorname{Spec}K\to X$ for fields $K$, identified if they agree over a common field extension; $|X_f|$ consists of classes factoring through $X_f$.

proof.text: Regard U as the actual representable fppf sheaf schemeSpace U, using [def-trf-scheme-algebraic-space]. Apply [lem-a1-space-etale-open-image] to its map f to X. Retain the open subfunctor A, its open-immersion scheme tests, and the factor ff with ff followed by the inclusion equal to f, ff etale and surjective.

Bundle A as an algebraic space without choosing new presheaf data. A representable presheaf over a sheaf is a sheaf: glue the images of a matching family in X, represent the pullback over the glued section, and glue the induced maps to that representing scheme using fppf subcanonicity. The diagonal of A is representable by composing A into X with the diagonal of X and cancelling the monomorphism A times A into X times X. Pull back an etale surjective scheme atlas of X along A to obtain one of A. Pasting representing pullback squares proves the base-change assertions. The inclusion has injective components because A is a subfunctor. Cancel its monomorphism from the representing scheme tests of f to obtain representability of ff.

For a K-valued section in A, test the surjective ff over Spec K. Choose a point of the representing scheme above the unique point of Spec K, and take its residue field L. The composite Spec L to Spec K corresponds by full faithfulness of Spec to a ring embedding K to L; evaluating the representing pullback square supplies the required lifted U-section. Conversely, a U-lift over L gives an A-section over L by ff. The open scheme test of A into X at the original K-section is therefore nonempty. Its map to Spec K is surjective since Spec K has one point; being an open immersion it is an isomorphism. Its inverse gives the original K-section in A. Naturality and ff followed by the inclusion equal to f give exactly the displayed field-extension equivalence.

lean.statement: theorem etaleSchemeMap_openImage {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (U : Over S) (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj.obj) (hf : IsRepresentable f) (he : IsEtale f) : ∃ (Xf : AlgebraicSpace S) (j : Xf ⟶ X) (ff : yoneda.obj U ⟶ Xf.obj.obj), (∀ T : (Over S)ᵒᵖ, Function.Injective (j.hom.hom.app T)) ∧ IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsOpenImmersion p.left) j.hom.hom ∧ ff ≫ j.hom.hom = f ∧ IsRepresentable ff ∧ IsSurjective ff ∧ IsEtale ff ∧ ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] (s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S) (x : X.obj.obj.obj (op (Over.mk s))), (∃ y : Xf.obj.obj.obj (op (Over.mk s)), j.hom.hom.app _ y = x) ↔ ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (e : K →+* L) (y : Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e) ≫ s) ⟶ U), f.app _ y = X.obj.obj.map (Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e)) rfl).op x
